# Geometry-Preserving Orthonormal Initialization for Low-Rank Adaptation in RLVR

> Official code and checkpoints for LoRA-RLPO and LoRA-RLMO, two geometry-preserving orthonormal LoRA initialization methods for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR).

Canonical paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.31813
Canonical repository: https://github.com/Richard-ZZZ/geometry-preserving-orthonormal-init-rlvr
Artifacts and checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/RuijiaZ/geometry-preserving-orthonormal-init-rlvr-artifacts

## Proposed methods

- LoRA-RLPO: Reinforcement Learning Principal Orthonormal initialization. For a pretrained weight W_0 = U Sigma V^T, initialize B_0 = 0 and A_0 = V_r^T, where V_r contains the top-r right singular vectors.
- LoRA-RLMO: Reinforcement Learning Minor Orthonormal initialization. Initialize B_0 = 0 and A_0 = V_{-r}^T, where V_{-r} contains the bottom-r right singular vectors.
- Both methods satisfy A_0 A_0^T = I_r and B_0 A_0 = 0. They preserve the pretrained function exactly at initialization and do not use singular-value scaling.

## Research question and contribution

The paper studies LoRA initialization for RLVR. It shows theoretically that row-orthonormal initialization of A_0 with B_0 = 0 minimizes the initialization-dependent term in a bound on the gap between LoRA and full fine-tuning. It also bounds the first-step update magnitude. The proposed LoRA-RLPO and LoRA-RLMO methods retain principal or minor spectral geometry from pretrained weights without the singular-value scaling used by PiSSA and MiLoRA.

## Main experimental setting

- Base model: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B
- Training algorithm: DAPO with GRPO advantage estimation
- Training data: DAPO-Math-17K
- Evaluation: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME 2022, AIME 2023, and AIME 2024
- Compared methods: standard LoRA, PiSSA, MiLoRA, LoRA-RLPO, and LoRA-RLMO
- Main average accuracy: LoRA-RLPO 65.03, LoRA-RLMO 63.76, standard LoRA 62.40

## Repository guide

- README.md: paper overview, exact initialization equations, comparison table, main results, and quick start
- docs/method.md: normative method specification and PEFT implementation mapping
- scripts/prepare_init_adapters.py: reference adapter initialization implementation
- scripts/run_rlpo_1p5b_paper_seed.sh: LoRA-RLPO training entry point
- scripts/run_rlmo_1p5b_paper_seed.sh: LoRA-RLMO training entry point
- manifests/experiments_1p5b.md: experiment and hyperparameter map
- CITATION.cff: machine-readable citation metadata
- codemeta.json: machine-readable software and research metadata
